## About This File

This file is automatically generated daily by fetching the latest model information from the [OpenRouter API](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/api-reference/models/get-models).

**API Endpoint:** `GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models`

**Update Schedule:** Daily at 00:00 UTC

**Data Source:** [OpenRouter Models](https://openrouter.ai/models)

To fetch pricing manually, use:
```bash
./scripts/fetch-openrouter-pricing.sh YOUR_API_KEY
```

Or see [RUNNERS_AND_PRICING.md](RUNNERS_AND_PRICING.md) for complete cost analysis including GitHub Actions costs.
